_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Supply and Delivery#000.src: Well? Did you buy the supply crate yet?
Supply and Delivery#000.dst: E aí? Comprou a caixa de suprimentos?
Supply and Delivery#000.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#001.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. It's not that hard!
Supply and Delivery#001.dst: Você só precisa ir ao Mercado e comprar a caixa de suprimentos para mim. Não é tão difícil!
Supply and Delivery#001.speaker: Ope

similar.text: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?

Supply and Delivery#002.src: You bought the crate! Good, good. You still need to pick it up from the Trade Market, though!
Supply and Delivery#002.dst: Você comprou a caixa! Bom, bom. Mas ainda precisa retirá-la no Mercado!
Supply and Delivery#002.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#003.src: Hey! I- uh, I can't help but notice that. You're still here. With the crate. You need to bring it to {p}, remember?
Supply and Delivery#003.dst: Ei! Eu- hã, não pude deixar de notar. Você ainda está aqui. Com a caixa. Precisa levá-la a {p}, lembra?

Supply and Delivery#004.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?
Supply and Delivery#004.dst: Quê? Não me olha assim! Foi uma troca justa e nós dois ganhamos. Eu fiquei com a planta, e você... bom. Ganhou experiência?
Supply and Delivery#004.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#005.src: So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
Supply and Delivery#005.dst: Então, ou você leva os suprimentos pra {p}... ou a gente foge, começa vida nova e evita as consequências dos nossos atos!
Supply and Delivery#005.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#006.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Sorry to say, but the wagon's broken down.
Supply and Delivery#006.dst: Opa! Quer carona até {p}? Sinto dizer, mas a carroça quebrou.

Supply and Delivery#007.src: I reckon it won't be long 'till it's fixed up, but you'll have to make the journey yourself for now.
Supply and Delivery#007.dst: Acho que não demora pra consertarem, mas por enquanto você vai ter que ir por conta própria.

Supply and Delivery#008.src: This fast travel requires Supply and Delivery to use.
Supply and Delivery#008.dst: Esta viagem rápida exige Suprimento e entrega.

Supply and Delivery#009.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we have recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#009.dst: Espero que estas esmeraldas bastem. Além disso... consertamos uma das nossas carroças quebradas, que faz a viagem até {p} e volta.
Supply and Delivery#009.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#011.src: Oh, man... What am I going to do now...
Supply and Delivery#011.dst: Ai, caramba... O que eu faço agora...
Supply and Delivery#011.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#012.src: O-oh! H-hello soldier! Wow, what a coincidence that we're both here... in {p}... today...
Supply and Delivery#012.dst: A-ah! O-olá, soldado! Nossa, que coincidência nós dois aqui... em {p}... hoje...
Supply and Delivery#012.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#013.src: Look, alright, I get it! But I can't pay you back either way. The mayor sent me here to pick up a crate of supplies for the village.
Supply and Delivery#013.dst: Olha, tá, eu entendi! Mas não tenho como te pagar mesmo. O prefeito me mandou buscar uma caixa de suprimentos pra vila.
Supply and Delivery#013.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#014.src: The issue is... I've already run out of money on- uh, unrelated purchases. And even if I had the money, I couldn't buy the supply crate anyway...
Supply and Delivery#014.dst: O problema é que... já gastei todo o dinheiro em- hã, compras sem relação. E mesmo com dinheiro, eu não poderia comprar a caixa...
Supply and Delivery#014.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#015.src: Those two over there who run the market banned me from ever using it after I tried to buy out the world's supplies of magical powders.
Supply and Delivery#015.dst: Aqueles dois que cuidam do mercado me baniram para sempre depois que tentei comprar todo o estoque de pós mágicos do mundo.
Supply and Delivery#015.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#016.src: Look, it's not my fault I'm making big market moves. I'm just, you know- smarter than all these other folks!
Supply and Delivery#016.dst: Olha, não é culpa minha se faço grandes jogadas no mercado. Eu só sou, sabe- mais esperto que todo mundo!
Supply and Delivery#016.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#017.src: ... The point is. I could really use your help right now! I- I promise, I'll pay you back for it this time.
Supply and Delivery#017.dst: ... A questão é. Eu queria muito sua ajuda agora! E- eu prometo que dessa vez te pago de volta.
Supply and Delivery#017.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#018.src: All you need to do is go over to the Trade Market, and buy the supply crate for me. Please?
Supply and Delivery#018.dst: Você só precisa ir ao Mercado e comprar a caixa de suprimentos para mim. Por favor?
Supply and Delivery#018.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#019.src: ... What? They also banned you from the market?! Well, great. What are we supposed to do now?
Supply and Delivery#019.dst: ... Quê? Também te baniram do mercado?! Que ótimo. E agora, o que a gente faz?
Supply and Delivery#019.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#020.src: Well, do you have any other friends we could get involved? There was... that other soldier guy, right? His name was... Tim. Or something.
Supply and Delivery#020.dst: Bom, você tem outros amigos pra envolver? Tinha... aquele outro soldado, né? O nome dele era... Tim. Ou algo assim.
Supply and Delivery#020.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#021.src: Look- alright, I get it, I'm a jerk who doesn't remember peoples' names! Could you just ask him to buy the supplies for us?? He's our last hope... probably.
Supply and Delivery#021.dst: Olha- tá, eu entendi, sou um babaca que esquece nomes! Dá pra pedir pra ele comprar os suprimentos?? Ele é nossa última esperança... acho.
Supply and Delivery#021.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#022.src: Purchase the supply crate from the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#022.dst: Compre a caixa de suprimentos no Mercado em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#023.src: Hey, good work! Now you'll need to pick up the supply crate.
Supply and Delivery#023.dst: Ei, bom trabalho! Agora retire a caixa de suprimentos.
Supply and Delivery#023.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#024.src: Find Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and convince him to buy the supply crate for you.
Supply and Delivery#024.dst: Encontre Tasim em [{~}, {~}, -{~}] e convença-o a comprar a caixa de suprimentos para você.

Supply and Delivery#025.src: Oh, hey {u}! Are you just here to hang out? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#025.dst: Ah, oi, {u}! Veio só passar o tempo? Ou- essa sua cara diz que veio por outra coisa.
Supply and Delivery#025.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#026.src: [{~}] Can you buy something from the Trade Market for me?
Supply and Delivery#026.dst: [{~}] Pode comprar uma coisa no Mercado para mim?

Supply and Delivery#027.src: I... guess so? Is there a reason you can't do it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#027.dst: Acho... que sim? Tem algum motivo para você não poder?
Supply and Delivery#027.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#028.src: ...You're banned from the market? How did you even manage that? We haven't even been in {p} for that long!
Supply and Delivery#028.dst: ...Você foi banido do mercado? Como conseguiu isso? A gente nem está em {p} há tanto tempo!
Supply and Delivery#028.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#029.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy... whatever it is you need.
Supply and Delivery#029.dst: Você- quê!? Deixa pra lá, prefiro não saber. Vamos, vá na frente. Eu compro... seja lá o que precisa.
Supply and Delivery#029.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#030.src: ...Oh. Well, that explains that. Though- is there a reason you can't get it yourself?
Supply and Delivery#030.dst: ...Ah. Bem, isso explica. Mas- tem algum motivo para você não poder retirar?
Supply and Delivery#030.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#031.src: You- what!? Nevermind, I don't actually want to know. Come on, lead the way. I'll buy whatever it is Ope needs.
Supply and Delivery#031.dst: Você- quê!? Deixa pra lá, prefiro não saber. Vamos, vá na frente. Eu compro o que o Ope precisar.
Supply and Delivery#031.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#032.src: Oh, hello . Are you here for training as well? Or- that look on your face tells me you're here for something else.
Supply and Delivery#032.dst: Ah, olá. Também veio treinar? Ou- essa sua cara diz que veio por outra coisa.
Supply and Delivery#032.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#033.src: Bring Tasim to the Trade Market at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#034.src: Alright. So I'm just buying a supply crate...
Supply and Delivery#034.dst: Certo. Então só compro a caixa...
Supply and Delivery#034.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#035.src: Here it is. I wish you luck with... whatever it is you're up to.
Supply and Delivery#035.dst: Aqui está. Boa sorte com... seja lá o que está aprontando.
Supply and Delivery#035.speaker: Tasim

Supply and Delivery#036.src: Return to Ope with the supply crate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Supply and Delivery#036.dst: Volte até Ope com a caixa de suprimentos em [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Supply and Delivery#037.src: Perfect! Now, quickly, come back over here, before those two realize you're working with me!
Supply and Delivery#037.dst: Perfeito! Agora, rápido, volte aqui antes que aqueles dois percebam que você está comigo!
Supply and Delivery#037.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#038.src: You got the item? Good. Good, good good.
Supply and Delivery#038.dst: Pegou o item? Bom. Bom, bom bom.
Supply and Delivery#038.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#039.src: Okay! Now, we're onto step two. So, you see, this package still needs to make it to {p}...
Supply and Delivery#039.dst: Ok! Agora vamos ao passo dois. Veja bem, este pacote ainda precisa chegar a {p}...
Supply and Delivery#039.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#040.src: And. Well. You're the one holding the crate, not me! So... you know!
Supply and Delivery#040.dst: E. Bem. É você que está com a caixa, não eu! Então... sabe como é!
Supply and Delivery#040.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#041.src: Fine, I'll take the crate to
Supply and Delivery#041.dst: Tá, eu levo a caixa até

Supply and Delivery#042.src: Great! You know the way by now, surely! No need for me to, uh, get in your way!
Supply and Delivery#042.dst: Ótimo! Você já deve saber o caminho! Não precisa que eu, hã, atrapalhe!
Supply and Delivery#042.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#043.src: Just take those supplies to {p}, and. Well. Things will work out.
Supply and Delivery#043.dst: É só levar esses suprimentos a {p}, e. Bem. Tudo vai dar certo.
Supply and Delivery#043.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#044.src: Why can't you just take the
Supply and Delivery#044.dst: Por que você não leva a

Supply and Delivery#046.src: Well, you see. I really don't want to do it. And I'm not going to!
Supply and Delivery#046.dst: Bom, sabe. Eu não quero mesmo fazer isso. E não vou!
Supply and Delivery#046.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#047.src: ...no? No. Okay. Worth a shot. Well, you know the way by now! No need for me to, uh, get in your way! Heh...
Supply and Delivery#047.dst: ...não? Não. Tá. Valeu a tentativa. Bom, você já sabe o caminho! Não precisa que eu, hã, atrapalhe! Hehe...
Supply and Delivery#047.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#048.src: He bought you the item? Good. Good, good good. Okay! That was... harder than expected.
Supply and Delivery#048.dst: Ele comprou pra você? Bom. Bom, bom bom. Ok! Isso foi... mais difícil que o esperado.
Supply and Delivery#048.speaker: Ope

Supply and Delivery#049.src: Bring the supply crate to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Supply and Delivery#049.dst: Leve a caixa de suprimentos ao prefeito Alvin em {p}, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Supply and Delivery#050.src: Ah, hello! What can I do for you today?
Supply and Delivery#050.dst: Ah, olá! Em que posso ajudar hoje?
Supply and Delivery#050.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#051.src: I have a supply crate from D
Supply and Delivery#051.dst: Trouxe uma caixa de suprimentos de Detlas.

Supply and Delivery#052.src: Ah... So you do. I thought I had sent Ope to pick that up...
Supply and Delivery#052.dst: Ah... É mesmo. Achei que tinha mandado o Ope buscar isso...
Supply and Delivery#052.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#053.src: More of his shenanigans, I suppose. I am sorry you have had to deal with him twice.
Supply and Delivery#053.dst: Mais uma travessura dele, imagino. Sinto muito por ter lidado com ele duas vezes.
Supply and Delivery#053.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#054.src: When he returns to the village, I'm going to need to have a word with him... Ah, but of course, I should pay you for your troubles.
Supply and Delivery#054.dst: Quando ele voltar à aldeia, vou ter uma conversa séria com ele... Ah, mas claro, devo te pagar pelo incômodo.
Supply and Delivery#054.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#055.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#055.dst: Fique à vontade para usá-la quando quiser! Em agradecimento por tudo que fez por nós.
Supply and Delivery#055.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#057.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#057.dst: Ele é um bom homem, de verdade. Acredito nisso de todo o coração. Mas tudo bem se você não pensa igual. Não vou te obrigar a lidar com ele se não quiser.
Supply and Delivery#057.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#058.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#058.dst: Ai, ai... Acho que foi há uns quinze anos que assumi o cargo, quando o antigo prefeito se afastou.
Supply and Delivery#058.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#059.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#059.dst: Ele era um homem gentil, sempre cuidando do povo. Mas, quando se aposentou, estava claro que se sentia inquieto na nossa cidadezinha.
Supply and Delivery#059.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#060.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#060.dst: Bem, assim que me passou o cargo, ele foi direto para {p} e se alistou no exército! Dizem que hoje ele treina soldados.
Supply and Delivery#060.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#061.src: Ah, but I've tried to live up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#061.dst: Ah, mas tentei honrar o legado dele. Gosto de pensar que me saí bem como prefeito!
Supply and Delivery#061.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#062.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#062.dst: Belo dia para estar de passagem! Aproveite a estadia.
Supply and Delivery#062.speaker: Mayor Alvin
